index.title: The Same Model, Twice
index.prompt: Implement a state-space model as both a recurrence and an FFT convolution, verify they agree to machine precision, and show a nonlinearity destroys the equivalence.
index.answer: Auto-graded inside the notebook. Outputs and kernel statistics must match to 1e-8, with the two linear forms agreeing to 1e-9 and the nonlinear one diverging.
